title: BUT Telepresence telemetry (InfluxDB 3)
description: Per-frame video, command path, camera head, audio and clock telemetry written by the relay. Stop grafana-server before measurement campaigns: its queries share the Jetson's CPU with the pipeline.

panels.title: Instrumented latency (last 10 s)
panels.description: Sum of the per-stage times of each displayed frame, camera stage modelled (not the optical glass-to-glass latency, which needs the rig).

targets.rawSql: SELECT median(total_latency_us) / 1000.0 AS "median", approx_percentile_cont(total_latency_us, 0.95) / 1000.0 AS "P95" FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE time > $__timeTo - interval '10 seconds' AND time <= $__timeTo AND frame_id > 0

panels.title: Frames shown per second (last 10 s)
panels.description: New frames that reached the display, against the configured frame rate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) / 10.0 AS "shown" FROM (SELECT time, frame_id, lag(frame_id) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE time > $__timeTo - interval '10 seconds' AND time <= $__timeTo AND frame_id > 0) WHERE prev IS NULL OR frame_id <> prev
SELECT max(fps_config) AS "configured" FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE time > $__timeTo - interval '10 seconds' AND time <= $__timeTo

panels.title: Longest gap between new frames (last 10 s)
panels.description: A freeze: the time the display showed the same frame. At 60 frames per second a frame normally lasts 17 ms; loss under an inter-frame codec shows up here, not in the per-stage times.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(gap_ms) AS "longest gap" FROM (SELECT time, (CAST(time AS BIGINT) - CAST(lag(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS BIGINT)) / 1e6 AS gap_ms FROM (SELECT time, frame_id, lag(frame_id) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE time > $__timeTo - interval '10 seconds' AND time <= $__timeTo AND frame_id > 0) WHERE prev IS NULL OR frame_id <> prev)

panels.title: Command path, M2M (last 10 s)
panels.description: Head-pose packet: headset send time to the relay on the robot (NTP-corrected clocks).

targets.rawSql: SELECT median(m2m_command_us) / 1000.0 AS "median" FROM control_metrics WHERE time > $__timeTo - interval '10 seconds' AND time <= $__timeTo AND m2m_command_us IS NOT NULL

SELECT sum(CASE WHEN dl > 0 THEN dl ELSE 0 END) + sum(CASE WHEN dr > 0 THEN dr ELSE 0 END) AS "lost" FROM (SELECT left_lost - lag(left_lost) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS dl, right_lost - lag(right_lost) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS dr FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE time > $__timeTo - interval '10 seconds' AND time <= $__timeTo)

panels.title: Clock
panels.description: Whether the headset's clock is synchronised to the robot's; the per-frame times depend on it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ntp_synced FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Latency per stage (medians, stacked)
panels.description: Median of each stage per interval, stacked in pipeline order. The camera stage is the model constant.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, median(camera_us) / 1000.0 AS "camera (model)", median("vidConv_us") / 1000.0 AS "conversion", median(enc_us) / 1000.0 AS "encoder", median("rtpPay_us") / 1000.0 AS "RTP payloader", median("udpStream_us") / 1000.0 AS "network", median("jbHold_us") / 1000.0 AS "jitter buffer", median("rtpDepay_us") / 1000.0 AS "RTP depayloader", median(dec_us) / 1000.0 AS "decoder", median(appsink_us) / 1000.0 AS "appsink", median(presentation_us) / 1000.0 AS "presentation" FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND frame_id > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT median(camera_us) / 1000.0 AS "camera (model)", median("vidConv_us") / 1000.0 AS "conversion", median(enc_us) / 1000.0 AS "encoder", median("rtpPay_us") / 1000.0 AS "RTP payloader", median("udpStream_us") / 1000.0 AS "network", median("jbHold_us") / 1000.0 AS "jitter buffer", median("rtpDepay_us") / 1000.0 AS "RTP depayloader", median(dec_us) / 1000.0 AS "decoder", median(appsink_us) / 1000.0 AS "appsink", median(presentation_us) / 1000.0 AS "presentation" FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE time > $__timeTo - interval '10 seconds' AND time <= $__timeTo AND frame_id > 0

SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, median(total_latency_us) / 1000.0 AS "median", approx_percentile_cont(total_latency_us, 0.95) / 1000.0 AS "P95" FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND frame_id > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, count(*) * 1000.0 / $__interval_ms AS "shown" FROM (SELECT time, frame_id, lag(frame_id) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND frame_id > 0) WHERE prev IS NULL OR frame_id <> prev GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, max(fps_config) AS "configured" FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Freezes: longest gap between new frames
panels.description: Longest time one frame stayed on the display, per interval.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, max(gap_ms) AS "longest gap" FROM (SELECT time, (CAST(time AS BIGINT) - CAST(lag(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS BIGINT)) / 1e6 AS gap_ms FROM (SELECT time, frame_id, lag(frame_id) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND frame_id > 0) WHERE prev IS NULL OR frame_id <> prev) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, sum(CASE WHEN dl > 0 THEN dl ELSE 0 END) * 1000.0 / $__interval_ms AS "left eye", sum(CASE WHEN dr > 0 THEN dr ELSE 0 END) * 1000.0 / $__interval_ms AS "right eye" FROM (SELECT time, left_lost - lag(left_lost) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS dl, right_lost - lag(right_lost) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS dr FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Head speed while frames are shown
panels.description: Angular speed of the operator's head at the predicted display time of each render (headset telemetry).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, median(head_rate_dps) AS "median", approx_percentile_cont(head_rate_dps, 0.95) AS "P95" FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND head_rate_dps IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Head turn during a frame's latency
panels.description: Head speed at display multiplied by the frame's instrumented latency: how far the head turned while the frame travelled from the camera to the display, the product of latency and head velocity that the sickness literature relates to discomfort. Without a forecast this is the view's misregistration; a forecast reduces it for the camera head's part.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, median(head_rate_dps * total_latency_us / 1e6) AS "median", approx_percentile_cont(head_rate_dps * total_latency_us / 1e6, 0.95) AS "P95", max(head_rate_dps * total_latency_us / 1e6) AS "max" FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND head_rate_dps IS NOT NULL AND frame_id > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Display refresh rate
panels.description: From the interval between successive renders' display times. The app requests 120 Hz (debug.but.refresh_rate to change it); the headset lowers it to 72 Hz when it throttles for heat. The thesis's measurements were made at 90 Hz.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, 1e6 / median(dd) AS "refresh" FROM (SELECT time, display_time_us - lag(display_time_us) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS dd FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND display_time_us IS NOT NULL) WHERE dd > 0 AND dd < 50000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Retransmissions per second
panels.description: RTP retransmissions answered (NACK), when retransmission is switched on.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, sum(CASE WHEN dl > 0 THEN dl ELSE 0 END) * 1000.0 / $__interval_ms AS "left eye", sum(CASE WHEN dr > 0 THEN dr ELSE 0 END) * 1000.0 / $__interval_ms AS "right eye" FROM (SELECT time, left_rtx - lag(left_rtx) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS dl, right_rtx - lag(right_rtx) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS dr FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, median(left_jitter_us) / 1000.0 AS "left eye", median(right_jitter_us) / 1000.0 AS "right eye" FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, avg(left_bitrate_bps) AS "left eye", avg(right_bitrate_bps) AS "right eye", max(bitrate_cfg) AS "configured" FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Camera head pan: head, forecast, command, drive
panels.description: All in head yaw: the drive's values are mapped back through the relay's head-to-motor mapping. Zoom in to a few seconds to see the delays. The relay's 'el' drive takes the head's yaw (axis swap).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, degrees(avg(meas_el_rad)) AS "head", degrees(avg(fc_el_rad)) AS "forecast", degrees(avg(filt_el_rad)) AS "filtered command" FROM servo_command WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__dateBin(s.time) AS time, degrees(avg((s.pg_el - m.b) / m.k)) AS "drive setpoint", degrees(avg((s.act_el - m.b) / m.k)) AS "measured position" FROM servo_state s CROSS JOIN (SELECT regr_slope(meas_el_motor, meas_el_rad) AS k, regr_intercept(meas_el_motor, meas_el_rad) AS b FROM servo_command WHERE $__timeFilter(time)) m WHERE $__timeFilter(s.time) AND s.timeout = false GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Camera head tilt: head, forecast, command, drive
panels.description: All in head pitch: the drive's values are mapped back through the relay's head-to-motor mapping. Zoom in to a few seconds to see the delays. The relay's 'az' drive takes the head's pitch (axis swap).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, degrees(avg(meas_az_rad)) AS "head", degrees(avg(fc_az_rad)) AS "forecast", degrees(avg(filt_az_rad)) AS "filtered command" FROM servo_command WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__dateBin(s.time) AS time, degrees(avg((s.pg_az - m.b) / m.k)) AS "drive setpoint", degrees(avg((s.act_az - m.b) / m.k)) AS "measured position" FROM servo_state s CROSS JOIN (SELECT regr_slope(meas_az_motor, meas_az_rad) AS k, regr_intercept(meas_az_motor, meas_az_rad) AS b FROM servo_command WHERE $__timeFilter(time)) m WHERE $__timeFilter(s.time) AND s.timeout = false GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, median(send_time_us - meas_time_us) / 1000.0 AS "head sample to send (headset)" FROM servo_command WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, median(m2m_command_us) / 1000.0 AS "send to relay (M2M)" FROM control_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND m2m_command_us IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Prediction lead set in the app
panels.description: The lead the application adds to the runtime's display time. The thesis counts prediction from the present: this lead plus the display-time lead of about 20 ms (the default lead of 40 ms is 60 ms from the present).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, max(prediction_ms) AS "lead" FROM control_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND prediction_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Drive read-back
panels.description: The relay polls the drive's setpoint and measured position at 200 Hz.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, median(t_recv_ns - t_send_ns) / 1e6 AS "round trip" FROM servo_state WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND timeout = false GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, sum(CASE WHEN timeout THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1000.0 / $__interval_ms AS "timeouts/s" FROM servo_state WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, avg(req_linear_x) AS "linear x", avg(req_linear_y) AS "linear y", avg(req_angular) AS "angular" FROM control_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND req_linear_x IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT codec, video_mode, resolution_width, resolution_height, fps_config, bitrate_cfg FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ntp_offset_us / 1000.0 AS "offset" FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT frame_id FROM pipeline_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, median(robot_to_headset_latency_us) / 1000.0 AS "robot to headset", median(headset_to_robot_latency_us) / 1000.0 AS "headset to robot" FROM audio_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, avg(tx_bitrate_bps) AS "robot to headset", avg(rx_bitrate_bps) AS "headset to robot" FROM audio_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Headset clock offset to the robot

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, median(offset_us) / 1000.0 AS "offset" FROM ntp_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Error bound, round trip, jitter, dispersion

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, median(offset_error_bound_us) / 1000.0 AS "error bound", median(rtt_min_us) / 1000.0 AS "min round trip", median(jitter_us) / 1000.0 AS "jitter", median(offset_dispersion_us) / 1000.0 AS "dispersion" FROM ntp_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, median(skew_ppm) AS "skew" FROM ntp_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
